mawk.definition:
mad awks.\r
When something is mad awkward, overly awkward, mawkward.\r
When someone says something weird and it leads to an uncomfortable silence.
> Standing next to someone you hate in uncomfortable silence.
> "Wow, that was mawks."
> When a teacher overhears a conversation they shouldn't have.
> "Mawks."
> When someone walks by and you hear only part of their conversation and it sounds really weird.
> "Mawks."
